name: Energy and Environment
description: Basic definitions of energy, environment and ecosystem, and their inter-relationship; mass and energy transfer; biological energy transfer and nutrient cycling; population dynamics; air pollution, water pollution, soil pollution, thermal pollution, e-waste pollution, global effects and climate change; environmental impact and mitigation techniques of energy resources and utilization.
